title: Coins and notes
summary: Recognise coin values and put pence coins in order.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 identifies 1p. Q2 reads 2p. Q3 identifies the 1p and 2p values. Q4 identifies 5p. Q5 reads 10p. Q6 identifies 20p. Q7 identifies the 20p and 50p values. Q8 reads 50p. Q9 identifies the current pound coin. Q10 orders four pence coins by value, not physical size. One question uses a single coin or note to pay an exact price.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy recognises common coin values with colour and shape as supporting hints. Medium introduces all four Bank of England note values, the two-pound coin and ordering notes. Hard adds new thinking by rejecting physical-size errors, distinguishing pounds from pence when numerals match, and comparing mixed denominations. No coin totals, equivalent combinations or change calculations are introduced.
